description:
## Bug Fixes

### YouTube and YouTube Music
- **Visual preferences icons:** `Bold (stock size)` rows use the spacing of the app's own settings: the icon and the text sit where they do in the stock Settings screen, including the SponsorBlock settings. `Regular` and `Bold` keep their current spacing.

## Compatibility
- YouTube: **21.39.525, 21.13.164, 20.05.46**.
- YouTube Music: **9.40.51, 9.15.51, 8.30.54**.

[Full changelog](https://github.com/lavinhoque33/revanced-patches/compare/v1.21.0...v1.21.1)
